meta.parties: Samaraweera v. Cunji Moosa Et Al

rules.statement: A sale under the Partition Ordinance is subject to existing leases, unless it is expressly declared to be free of them.
rules.supporting_quote: "I entirely agree with Pereira J. in Silva v. Soysa, 2 [(1913) 17 N. L. R. 67.] that there can he no objection to a lessee being made & party to the action, or to his rights being adjudicated upon and a suitable order made with reference to them. Section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code, with the reasonable necessity arising from the object of the Ordinance, is a sufficient authority for such, a course."
